name: Web Scraping -> Cleaned Data -> Sheets/DB with Alerts

parameters.content:
## Web scraping -> cleaned data -> Sheets/DB + alerts

Every 6 h this workflow fetches a listing page, extracts each product card, cleans & validates the fields, upserts valid rows into Google Sheets (and optionally Postgres) and posts a Slack alert when something looks wrong.

### Setup (5 min)
1. Open **Config** and set `target_url`, CSS selectors, `sheet_id`, `slack_channel`.
2. **Upsert to Google Sheets** -> add a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential. Sheet tab `listings` with header row:
`id | title | price | currency | url | availability | source | scraped_at | status | issues`
3. **Send Slack Alert** -> add a Slack credential (bot token, `chat:write`).
4. (Optional) Enable **Upsert to Postgres** and add a Postgres credential (see `schema.sql`).
5. Click *Execute workflow* once, check the sheet, then Activate.

Default target is the public scraping sandbox books.toscrape.com, so it works out of the box.

### 1. Config
All site-specific settings live here: URL, CSS selectors, Sheet ID, Slack channel, alert threshold. No other node needs editing to point the template at a new site.

### 2. Fetch
GET with a browser User-Agent, 30 s timeout, 3 retries. If it still fails, the **error output** goes to the alert branch instead of crashing the run.
Respect robots.txt and the site ToS.

### 3. Extract & clean
Cards are split into items, fields extracted per card (robust to missing fields), then **Clean & Normalize** trims text, parses US/EU prices + currency, makes URLs absolute, dedupes, and marks bad rows `status=invalid` with a reason.

### 4. Store
Only `status=ok` rows are upserted, keyed by `id` (canonical URL), so re-runs update prices instead of creating duplicates.

### 5. Alerts
Slack is pinged only when: the fetch failed, the page returned no listings (selectors broke), or the invalid-row ratio exceeds `max_invalid_ratio`. Healthy runs stay silent.
